title: Two slopes, one target
hook: One peak separates two different comparison rules.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Search a strict mountain array by finding the summit then using opposite comparison directions.

misconception: One binary-search direction works on both sides of a peak.
objective: Search a strict mountain array by finding the summit then using opposite comparison directions.

claims.text: The peak divides the input into two ordered sides. The descending side reverses the comparison rule; treating it as ascending discards the side that can contain the target.
